violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Spring mix (46F), romaine (52F), and kale (45F) observed in open salad display.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Items moved from walk in cooler at business open just before 11am, PIC stated items will be used or discarded by 3pm.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Salad Display observed at 57F. PIC stated unit has been under maintenance and waiting for a part.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Employee adjusted unit, thermometer observed at 35F at the end of the inspection. EHS discussed to use a 4hour time hold for lettuce in display case.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Quinoa (125F) and grilled chicken (131F) observed in Altoshaam hot hold.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC stated items were prepared 2 hours prior, PIC will discard leftover product after holding for a maximum of 4 hours.
